messages.author: bfc2eb6b71169017
messages.subject: Re: ggplot2 plotting
parts:
Is this what you're after?

prt <- read.table("clipboard", header = TRUE)
head(prt)
prt.melt <- melt(prt, id.vars = "position")
head(prt.melt)
ggplot(prt.melt, aes(x = position, y = value, colour = variable)) + geom_line() + theme_bw()
